unit.title: Variables, Expressions & Algebraic Structure
unit.essential_question: How does algebra preserve relationships, reveal structure, and let one expression represent many possible situations?
big_ideas: Variables can represent unknown, changing, or generalized quantities.
Terms, coefficients, constants, factors, and operations reveal an expression’s structure.
Substitution assigns values while order of operations preserves meaning.
Properties create equivalent expressions without changing value.
Algebraic models are useful only when variables, units, assumptions, and limitations are explicit.

lessons.title: Variables, Terms, Coefficients & Constants
objectives: Identify variables, terms, coefficients, constants, factors, and operations.
Distinguish an expression from an equation.
Describe expression structure using precise language.
Interpret implicit multiplication and signs.

lessons.title: Translating Words & Contexts into Expressions
objectives: Translate verbal phrases into algebraic expressions.
Define variables with units and context.
Distinguish additive and multiplicative comparisons.
Use grouping symbols to preserve meaning.

lessons.title: Evaluating Expressions by Substitution
objectives: Substitute numerical values for variables.
Use parentheses when substituting negative values.
Apply order of operations accurately.
Evaluate multi-variable expressions with units.

lessons.title: Properties of Operations & Equivalent Structure
objectives: Use commutative, associative, identity, and inverse properties.
Recognize when a property does not apply.
Rewrite expressions to calculate efficiently.
Justify equivalence using a named property.

lessons.title: Distributive Property & Factoring
objectives: Expand products using the distributive property.
Factor expressions by removing a common factor.
Handle negative factors and subtraction accurately.
Connect area models with algebraic structure.

lessons.title: Combining Like Terms & Simplifying Expressions
objectives: Identify like and unlike terms.
Combine coefficients of like terms.
Simplify multi-step expressions using distribution.
Verify equivalence by substitution.

lessons.title: Formulas & Multi-Variable Expressions
objectives: Interpret variables and units in formulas.
Evaluate multi-variable formulas.
Rewrite formulas using equivalent expressions.
Compare how changing one input affects output.

lessons.title: Structural Modelling, Patterns & Error Analysis
objectives: Build expressions from repeated patterns and contexts.
Choose an equivalent form suited to a question.
Test algebraic claims with structure and substitution.
Identify assumptions and limitations in models.

practice.title: Foundation Practice
practice.support: Guided vocabulary, translation, substitution, and like-term practice.

practice.title: Core Practice
practice.support: Complete practice across expression structure and modelling.

practice.title: Extended Practice
practice.support: Proof, counterexamples, parameter reasoning, and model critique.
